step-1.text: Flip the top onto something soft, underside up. Pre-drilled holes should be facing you.

step-2.text: Twist a double-ended screw into each corner hole by hand, halfway in. The other half is for the leg.

step-3.text: Twist on the first two legs, clockwise, until they are snug and straight. Hand tight is right.

step-4.text: And the last two. Check they all stand straight.

step-5.text: Turn it right side up. Lift it, don't drag it on two legs.

count-5.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your PARSONS coffee table is built. Give it a proud little pat.
